source.quote: SMSL's own page for the D400 SE, read 2026-11-27 with curl, « Introduction » bullets: « Fully balanced discrete design for ultra-high power output; »; « USB Audio lnput: Up to PCM 384kHz/32bit, DoP128, DSD256; »

_the_ceiling_is_the_XMOS_bullet: The rate and DSD ceilings come from the bullet naming the XMOS USB receiver, so they are written on usb only. No other input is given a PCM rate: the page states none.
_no_converter_named_and_lower_than_its_s: No chip, no XMOS part, and a USB ceiling of 384 kHz / DSD256 with DoP128 - half the D400 MK2's figures. family is absent. « Fully balanced discrete design » is about the headphone stage (« for ultra-high power output »), not the converter. « lnput » is the page's own spelling.
